answer_1.quote: We conducted experiments across three primary application areas of language models: chatting, mathematical reasoning, and code writing.
answer_1.outputs: The paper evaluates generated responses across various linguistic styles such as length, readability, complexity, sentiment, and politeness.

answer_2.quote: We employ perplexity (PPL) as a supplementary metric to evaluate response quality in Appendix C.2.

answer_3.quote: To evaluate response quality, we employed Ministral-8B-Instruct (MistralAI, 2024) as an evaluator to assess whether responses adequately addressed the given instructions.
